text:
sam: noticed a spike of SCIM retries for tenant=beta-suite after the OIDC client rotation at 03:10. Many 403s and decryption errors.

lex: any logs? could be token audience or key id mismatches from rotation.

sam: paste: ```2026-04-02T03:12:05Z ERROR scim.provision decrypt failed tenant=beta-suite err=DecryptionFailure: encryption context mismatch (expected: role=admin, got: role=admin-renamed) obj=svc-42 trace=tx-9c3```

nina: looks like RBAC rename + OIDC client rotation overlapped. We tag role in KMS context. If the role label was changed before a rewrap, decrypts break.

lex: short fix: enable tenant-scoped fallback attempt using prior context values for 6 hours. I'll prepare a tiny patch.

ops-bot: deploy request queued: patch/provisioner/fallback -> staging.

idp-proxy-bot: role-snapshot for tenant=beta-suite: {old: "admin", new: "admin-renamed", changed_at: "2026-04-02T03:09:58Z"}

sre-oncall: FYI enabling fallback will double KMS decrypts for affected flows. I'll lower KMS alert thresholds and watch for throttling.

nina: plan a rewrap-run after fallback stabilizes. Must emit audit events with job_id and per-object records. Compliance will need a short timeline.

sam: support ping queued to BetaSuite CSM explaining root cause and mitigation. Will follow up with postmortem.

lex: staging deploy green; enabling flag for beta-suite now.```/admin/flags set provisioner.fallback_beta-suite=true```

sam: early staging run shows ~7 fallbacks and 0 new failures. good signal. reconvene after rewrap dry-run.
